services.name: Party package
services.desc: Stuff-A-Monkey Party Packagehis party package offers our own custom Sock Monkey, named Burrito, ready to stuff. This is great for kids (or anyone) who would like to make a Monkey without sewing. Add a heart or a star with a special sentiment on it. There is a birth certificate for every new Sock Monkey, and a variety of clothing options to dress and personalize your new, cuddly friend: a Superhero, a Cowgirl, a Pirate and more! Stuff-A-Monkey Package includes Museum tour, scavenger hunt, our custom stuffable Burrito Sock Monkey (or other animal) with stuffing pack (so that each guest can stuff their own friend), heart insert, and birth certificate. Up to 2 hours party time. $35.00 per
